item.title: Near record highs to finish February, turning wet in March
item.description: The last few days of February will be warm and sunny, but a cold front will move in on Saturday night, bringing waves of showers and potentially flooding to the area through the first week of March.

item.title: Missouri House votes to bolster student free-speech protections at public schools
item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. — A bill billed as the “SPEAKS Act” to bolster students’ rights to religious, political and ideological expression in Missouri public schools cleared the House on Thursday and heads to the Senate. item.title: Ozarks First's Carissa Codel to appear on The Mystery Hour
item.description: Carissa Codel, Ozarks First News Anchor, will be the special guest on The Mystery Hour this Friday at Mother's Brewing Company to discuss her viral reaction videos of reading troll comments.

item.title: How to donate to the families of the fallen Christian County deputies
item.description: Individuals and businesses in Ozark, Mo. are stepping up to help the families of two Christian County Sheriff's deputies killed and two others injured, by donating to the Christian County Deputy Sheriff's Association, Hy-Vee stores, the Christian County 100 Club, B-29 Café, and Hurt's Donuts.
